name: frontend-dependency-contract-reconciliation
body: The dependency contract covers seven language frontends plus the bundled structural scanner. `requirements.requirement.frontend-dependency-contract`, `frontend-build-deps`, `frontend-scan-deps`, `frontend-engine-pin`, and `frontend-dependency-docs` state the seven-plus-bundle set; the Markdown row folds into the bundled-scanner row. `requirements.note.frontend-dependency-matrix` carries the seven-plus-bundle matrix. `global.constraint.frontend-dependency-contract` covers every frontend apg ships, including the bundled structural scanner. `solution.container.build-pipeline` carries eight artifacts — seven frontends plus the bundle — and `apg-md` retires. `solution.component.frontend-dependency-docs` states the seven-plus-bundle set. The docs anchors `AGENTS.md` and `README.md` resolve.
